verdict.rationale: Formant is an API- and SDK-driven platform, so an interactive API reference is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence only shows that Agent SDK and Cloud SDK documentation and reference pages exist. Nothing shows an interactive explorer or runnable 'try it' examples, and the OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
